text.description_html:
Baldwin 0381 Heavy Duty Solid Brass 12" Surface Slide Bolts.

This is a Solid brass 12" surface mounted security door bolt.

Each 12" surface bolt is supplied with 3 strikes: Universal, Mortise, and Angle strike with matching solid brass Phillip's head screws.

Specifications for Baldwin 0381 12 Inch Surface Bolt

  • Bolt Length: 12"
  • Rod Width 0.625"
  • Guide Width 1.75"
  • Large 1.25" Diameter Knob
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Strikes: Includes 3 Strikes

Special order item. NOT Returnable
